rules.name: Bisection method rule
rules.output_form: nested bracketing intervals for a root
preconditions: f is continuous on the interval and changes sign across endpoints
rules.operation: Halve the interval repeatedly while preserving a certified root bracket.
examples: Sign changes on a continuous interval justify bisection root isolation
counterexamples: Using bisection without a sign change on the interval is invalid as a certified root-bracketing method

rules.name: Newton iteration rule
preconditions: f'(x_n) is nonzero
rules.operation: Update a root approximation using tangent-line linearization.
examples: Newton iteration uses tangent-line intersections to accelerate root finding near a simple root
counterexamples: Dividing by a zero derivative is invalid

rules.name: Trapezoidal quadrature rule
preconditions: The integrand is defined at the interval endpoints
rules.operation: Approximate an integral by the area under the endpoint interpolating trapezoid.
examples: Trapezoidal quadrature approximates area by a linear interpolant across the interval
counterexamples: Treating the trapezoidal rule as exact for arbitrary nonlinear functions is invalid

rules.name: Forward Euler time step rule
preconditions: Step size h and current state are specified
rules.operation: Advance an ODE approximation explicitly using the current slope.
examples: Explicit Euler advances an ODE solution using the slope at the current step
counterexamples: Using a future-time slope in the explicit Euler formula is invalid

rules.name: LU factorization solve rule

rules.operation: Reduce a linear solve to forward and backward substitution using triangular factors.

rules.name: Lagrange interpolation formula
preconditions: Interpolation nodes are distinct

rules.name: QR least-squares solve rule

counterexamples: Using the same reduced triangular solve when rank assumptions fail is invalid
